import glob
files = sorted(glob.glob('.saipen/saitranslate/kitchen/*/README_*.md'))
changed = []
for p in files:
    t = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
    n = t.count('**v8.0.0**')
    if n == 1:
        open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(t.replace('**v8.0.0**', '**v8.0.1**'))
        changed.append(p)
    elif n > 1:
        print('MULTIPLE', p, n)
print('changed:', len(changed), 'of', len(files))
EOF
